description: Each mapped Go public symbol names its Rust owner, Rust surface, wrapper shape, and Go mechanical-port function.
Wrapper bodies remain in apiemit templates; this manifest carries parameters only.
Every mapped symbol in public_api_routing_inventory.json must appear exactly once in emit or deferred.
Symbols already classified as excluded by the public routing inventory are outside this mapping.
